title.credit: Adapted from the short story by Temesgen Gebre (Addis Ababa, 1948)

audience: Family and friends: the full story for people who want more than the 90-second film, shared on WhatsApp and YouTube.
intent: DRAFT - confirm: viewers laugh at Tebeje first, then feel the weight of a promise that keeps breaking, and end on Weyzero Tiruneshe's line knowing the first Amharic short story is funny, sad and still true.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion

shots.image_prompt: dusk on a dirt road in Gulele between tall eucalyptus trees and thatched huts, Tebeje staggers drunk down the road holding two live chickens by their feet, neighbours watch from doorways
shots.narration: በጉለሌ የነበረው የታወቀ ዶሮ ነጋዴ ማነው ብለው ከገፈርሳ እስከ ደጃዝማች ይገዙ ሠፈር ለጠየቁ ሰዎች፤ ተበጀ፣ ሰካራሙ ተበጀ፣ ዶሮ ነጋዴው ተበጀ ነው ብለው ይነግሯቸዋል።
shots.subtitle: If people from Gefersa to Dejazmach Yigezu's quarter asked who the famous chicken trader of Gulele was, they were told: Tebeje. Tebeje the drunk. Tebeje the chicken trader.

shots.reason: Shows the lovable, noisy drunk Gulele knows.
shots.image_prompt: night on a Gulele street lit by a shop lantern, drunk Tebeje laughing loudly and giving a clumsy military salute to passers-by
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ቢያውቀውም ባያውቀውም ላገኘው ሁሉ ማታ ሰላምታ ይሰጣል። ቢያውቀውም ባያውቀውም ካገኘው ሁሉ ጋራ ማታ ይስቃል።
shots.subtitle: Whether he knew them or not, at night he greeted everyone. Whether he knew them or not, at night he laughed with everyone.

shots.reason: Shows how Tebeje became Gulele's legend: every drunk story is told about him.
shots.image_prompt: inside a smoky Gulele home at night, elderly Ethiopian women in white netela shawls sit around a jebena coffee pot on a small charcoal fire, sipping from small finjal cups and laughing as they tell stories, warm firelight
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ቡን በተፈላ ጊዜ በጉለሌ በየምድጃው ሥር የሰካራም ተረት የተጫወተው ሰው ሁሉ የተናገረ በተበጀ ላይ ነው። መልኩን አይተውት ያላወቁ ባልቴቶች እንኳ ከፍንጃል ቡኑን ፉት እያሉ የሌላውን ሰካራም ተረት በተበጀ ላይ ይላክኩት ነበር።
shots.subtitle: When coffee was brewed by every hearth in Gulele, every drunkard's tale anyone told was told about Tebeje. Even old widows who had never seen his face sipped from their cups and pinned other drunks' stories on him.

shots.beat: A stranger out of the eucalyptus
shots.reason: The legend becomes a man: worse or better than they say, he walks out of the forest.
shots.image_prompt: misty morning, Tebeje walks out of a dense eucalyptus forest on the Gulele hills toward the camera, a lone strange figure, Addis Ababa rooftops far below in the haze
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ይህ እውነት ነበር። በጠባዩ ከተባለበት የባሰ ሰካራም ይሁን ወይም የተሻለ የጉለሌ ባሕር ዛፍ ውስጥ ወጥቶ አንድ አዲስ እንግዳ ሰው ሆኖ ለአዲስ አበባ ታይቷል።
shots.subtitle: This was true. Whether worse than they said or better, he came out of Gulele's eucalyptus and appeared to Addis Ababa as a strange new man.

shots.reason: Places his home exactly, as the story does; sets up the house that matters.
shots.image_prompt: late afternoon, an old wooden timber customs post beside a dirt road, a small river with a simple wooden bridge leading east, and just across it a small thatched hut among eucalyptus trees, Gulele 1940s
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ከዱሮው የእንጨት ጉምሩክ አጠገብ ወደ ምሥራቅ ሲል ካለው ወንዝ ማዶ ድልድዩን ወደ ምሥራቅ ተሻግሮ መጀመሪያ የሚገኘው አነስተኛ ሳር ክዳን ቤት የተበጀ ቤት ማለት ያ ነው። በዚያው በቤቱ በዚያው በጉለሌ በሠፈሩ ኖረ።
shots.subtitle: By the old timber customs, heading east, across the bridge over the river, the first small thatched hut you reach: that is Tebeje's house. There, in that house, in Gulele, he lived.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.reason: The house is his pride and the stakes of the story.
shots.image_prompt: Tebeje stands before his small newly built thatched hut beside a river and a wooden bridge, a tear running down his cheek, golden late afternoon light
shots.narration: እንጨቱን ተሸክሞ አፈሩን ቆፍሮ ቤቱን የሰራው እርሱ ነው። ዋጋ ከፍሎ አስከድኖታል። ተበጀን ኩራት ተሰማው።
shots.subtitle: He carried the timber and dug the earth; he built the house himself and paid for the thatch. Tebeje felt proud.

shots.reason: A close moment of pride and tenderness.
shots.image_prompt: extreme close-up of Tebeje's weathered face, a tear rolling down his cheek, his left palm wiping it away, warm golden light
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ቆይቶ ደግሞ ዓይኖቹ እንባ አዘሉ። በጉንጩም የእንባ ዘለላ ወረደው። በግራ እጁ መዳፍ ከጉንጩ የተንከባለለውን እንባ ጨፈለቀው።
shots.subtitle: Then his eyes filled with tears. A tear ran down his cheek, and he crushed it with the palm of his left hand.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.reason: Turning point: he hears his own reputation and is shaken.
shots.image_prompt: inside a dark thatched hut lit by a single kuraz oil lamp, Tebeje holds his head in his hands, shocked and ashamed
shots.narration: ‹ዶሮ ነጋዴው የትኛው ነው?› ሲባል ‹ያ የጉለሌው ሰካራም› ሊባል ነው። አወይ! እኔ ተበጀ፤ ተበላሽቻለሁ አለና ደነገጠ።
shots.subtitle: 'Which chicken trader?' 'That drunkard of Gulele.' 'Oh! Me, Tebeje, I am ruined,' he said, shaken.

shots.beat: For the honour of the house
shots.reason: His first vow to quit.
shots.image_prompt: Tebeje holds a matchbox beside an unlit kuraz oil lamp in his dark hut, a row of liquor bottles on a shelf behind him, a hard decision on his face
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ከዚህ በኋላ ስለ ቤቱ ክብር እንኳ መጠጥ መተው ይገባኛል አለ።
shots.subtitle: 'From now on, for the honour of this house at least, I must quit drinking,' he said.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.reason: The vow breaks the same night; the laugh keeps him human.
shots.image_prompt: night, full moon, Tebeje sits drunk on the ground under a huge eucalyptus tree, raising a whisky bottle to the moonlight and laughing, empty bottles around him
shots.narration: ጉለሌ ተኝቷልና ከዚሁ ከባሕር ዛፍ ሥር ቁጭ ብዬ ብጠጣ የሚታዘበኝ የለም አለና አሰበ።
shots.subtitle: 'Gulele is asleep. If I sit under this eucalyptus and drink, no one will see me,' he thought.

shots.reason: The comic relapse under the moon.
shots.image_prompt: night, Tebeje holds a whisky bottle up against the full moon to see how much is left, bursting into laughter
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ‹ግማሹን ያህል ሰርጉጀዋለሁ› አለና በሳቅ ፈነዳ።
shots.subtitle: 'I've slurped about half of it,' he said, and burst out laughing.

shots.reason: His courage: he is the only one who goes into the water.
shots.image_prompt: a swollen brown river in heavy rain, villagers in white gabis lined up on the bank watching, Tebeje diving into the rushing water
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ‹ገረዲቱን እናንተ በመጨረሻ ያያችኋት ወዴት ነው?› ብሎ ጠየቀና እየጠለቀ በዋና ይፈልግ ጀመር።
shots.subtitle: 'Where did you last see the maid?' he asked, and began diving and swimming to find her.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.reason: His only brave deed becomes a joke: a drunk's courage counts for nothing.
shots.image_prompt: a muddy riverbank after a flood, Tebeje lies soaked and exhausted beside a big wet pig, villagers in gabis behind him laughing
shots.narration: ‹ሴትዮዋ ድናለች?› ብሎ በርኅራሄ ድምፅ ጠየቃቸው። አንዱ ቀረበና ‹አሳማ ነው ያወጣኸው› አለው።
shots.subtitle: 'Is the woman saved?' he asked tenderly. One came closer: 'It's a pig you pulled out.'

shots.reason: The theme: his goodness counts for nothing because he drinks.
shots.image_prompt: on a muddy riverbank villagers point and laugh at soaked Tebeje sitting alone, head bowed, grey overcast light
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: መልካሙ የሰማዕትነት ሥራው ሁሉ ደግሞ እንዲሁ ርካሽ ሆኖ የሚቆጠር የሆነበት ዘወትር የሚሰክር ሆኖ ስለታወቀ ነው።
shots.subtitle: All his good, brave deeds were counted cheap, because he was known to be always drunk.

shots.reason: Real change: he stops drinking for the house.
shots.image_prompt: morning, a clean and calm Tebeje sits on a low stool in his hut drinking water from a tin cup, two dogs asleep at his feet, sunlight through the doorway
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ቤቱን ከሰራ ከአምስት ወራቶች በኋላ ጀምሮ ተበጀ መጠጥ ከቶ አልጠጣም።
shots.subtitle: From five months after he built the house, Tebeje never drank at all.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.reason: After nearly two sober years, the craving wins.
shots.image_prompt: night, Tebeje lies awake on his wooden bed in his dark hut, staring at the door, restless and tempted, moonlight across his face
shots.narration: ሹልክ ብዬ ዛሬ ብቻ፣ ጥቂት ብቻ፣ አንድ ጊዜ ብቻ፣ እኔ ብቻ፣ ብጠጣ ምን ይጐዳል
shots.subtitle: 'If I slip out, just today, just a little, just once, just me... what harm could it do?'

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.reason: His old drinking friends welcome him back like a hero.
shots.image_prompt: inside a crowded smoky 1940s Addis Ababa tavern lit by oil lamps, cheering drunk men carry Tebeje on their shoulders, raising bottles like palm branches
shots.narration: እንደተወደደ መሪ በጫንቃቸው ላይ ተሸክመው እየተቀባበሉት በእልልታ ጮሁ።
shots.subtitle: Like a beloved leader they carried him on their shoulders, passing him along, cheering.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.reason: The price of drink, shown without gore.
shots.image_prompt: grey dawn, Tebeje lies broken in tall dry grass beside an old railway track, a dead donkey nearby, vultures landing
shots.narration: ከኋላው በኩል ትልቅ ኀይል መታው። ከፊቱ በኩል የቀበሮ ጉድጓድ ተቀበለው። እግሩ እንደ ብርጭቆ ነከተ።
shots.subtitle: A great force struck him from behind. A fox hole caught him in front. His leg shattered like glass.

shots.reason: The nightmare's cruel climax, kept off-screen.
shots.image_prompt: a dim 1940s hospital ward, doctors in white coats stand around Tebeje lying on an iron bed, a single hanging lamp, shadows
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ሌላው ግን ‹ሁለተኛ እንዳይሰክር ከቂጡ አስጠግቼ እቆርጠዋለሁ› አለና ከቂጡ አስጠግቶ ቆረጠው።
shots.subtitle: But another said, 'So he never drinks again, I'll cut it off at the hip,' and he did.

shots.reason: The twist: it was a dream.
shots.image_prompt: night in the hut, two dogs fighting over a bone on top of Tebeje's bed, Tebeje jolting awake in terror
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: በዚህ ጊዜ በአጥንት የተጣሉት ውሾች በላዩ ላይ ተረፋረፉበትና በድንጋፄ ከእንቅልፉ ነቃ።
shots.subtitle: Just then the dogs fighting over a bone tumbled onto him, and he woke in terror.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.beat: How many legs do I have?
shots.reason: The dream breaks; the comic, human exchange releases the tension.
shots.image_prompt: night inside the hut, Tebeje sits up in bed sweating and terrified, clutching his legs, Weyzero Tiruneshe stands holding a small oil lamp
shots.narration: ‹ስንት እግር ነው ያለኝ?› ብሎ ጠየቃቸው። ወይዘሮ ጥሩነሽም ‹ዱሮ ስንት እግር ነበረዎ ጌታ?› ብለው ጠየቁት።
shots.subtitle: 'How many legs do I have?' he asked. Weyzero Tiruneshe replied, 'How many did you have before, sir?'

shots.reason: Relief: the dream was not real; he tries to kiss his own leg.
shots.image_prompt: inside the hut at night by oil lamp light, Tebeje bends forward trying to kiss his own leg, Weyzero Tiruneshe watches calmly with a faint smile
shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.narration: ‹በእርግጥ ሁለት እግሮች አሉዎት ጌታ› አሉት። ተበጀ እግሩን አጐንብሶ ለመሳም ሞከረና ራቀው።
shots.subtitle: 'Truly, you have two legs, sir,' she said. Tebeje bent to kiss his leg, but it was too far.

shots.video_prompt: slow gentle camera move, subtle natural motion
shots.reason: His biggest vow and her quiet doubt; the viewer decides.
shots.image_prompt: Tebeje stands in the doorway of his thatched hut looking up at a starry night sky, Weyzero Tiruneshe in the shadow behind him holding the lamp
shots.narration: ወደ ሰማይ እያየ ‹መጠጥ ማለት ለእኔ ሞት ማለት ነው› አለ። ጊዜውም ሌሊት ነበር። ‹እንደዚህ የማሉበት ሌሊት ያልፋል› ብለው ወይዘሮ ጥሩነሽ መለሱለት።
shots.subtitle: Looking at the sky he said, 'For me, drink means death.' It was night. 'Nights of such vows pass,' Weyzero Tiruneshe replied.
